reviews.review:
This game is almost good in a lot of ways but constantly shoots itself in the foot. However if you suffer from the same disease that I do in which you're obligated to play every single Souls-like on the market then maybe this game is right up your alley!

Straight up though Immortal: Unchained is kind of a mess. It looks like a third person shooter but it's kind of not really because if you try to play it like one you'll have an awful time. The game requires you to use its weird lock-on system to even have a chance to beat certain enemies but it's janky as hell. The game is also full of bugs with enemies shooting through walls, lots of ways to get stuck, and just some real strange collision problems. Everything just feels off in a way that's really hard to describe.

On top of that the weapons are boring as all hell. They look like they were taken from a free real world guns asset pack and had some glowy bits slapped on. Nothing feels good to shoot, the powers are boring, and grenades and melee are almost completely worthless. Whatever you do don't be tricked by the character creation screen and think that melee is at all viable in this game. There's on basic attack and enemies don't even react to it, it's broken and awful.

On top of that is maybe the worst stat and weapon requirement system I've ever seen in a game. Want to use any of the neat looking shotguns you've found? Welp you're going to have to dump all your stats into strength which only helps with melee attacks which are useless. Oh how about assault rifles? Guess you're specializing in...reload speed? All of the requirements for anything are WAY too high and with only one respec per playthrough (which wasn't even there at launch) you'll only ever get to try a fraction of the guns in this game. Hope you like the starting weapons for ten hours!

The enemies are cheap and frustrating as hell too. You're supposed to hit their weak spots but every enemy has them on their back and rotates on a dime to face you almost at all times even during attacks. Oh the enemy is standing in front of a wall or in a tight hallway? Sorry I guess you're just screwed, play a better game.

Yes there's some enjoyment to be had here. The level design is often quite good with lots of secrets to find and the actual unique bosses are pretty cool if weirdly easy as hell but it's not even to save this game. If the devs would just rebalance some of the stat requirements for weapons and toned down the enemy animation jank and ability to get stunlocked to death it would go a long way to making Immortal: Unchained way better but it seems like that's just not going to happen. I'm just glad I didn't play this game new when your weapons had 2-3X less range than they do now. Oh and the enemies? Their shots have infinite range and no leash. Awful.

e: I almost forgot the worst two things about this game. Almost all of the enemies are invisible and just appear out of nowhere when you get close to where they're supposed to be. Expecting to make an educated plan about how to explore an area? Nope sorry not the game for that. Also there are WAY too many enemies that instantly and incessantly teleport everywhere non-stop and it might be one of the most obnoxious things I've ever seen in a game.

Tried to Refund and Steam refused, maybe I went over the 2 weeks to play under 2 hours. whatever the case. 
The game is bad, not because it's grindy, not because early bosses one shot you.


It's BECAUSE of the BUGS  - the levels and parkour and holes in the map are all over the place. 

You get caught on so many cracks. The shooting is somewhat like resident evil, move slow when you aim.

Alright a years have past... has it improved in 2023?
